content: यायावर {%a.%} Frequently going, vagrant, having no fixed abode. .{@-रः@} .²1 A vagrant mendicant, saint; यायावराः पुष्पफलेन चान्ये प्रानर्चुरर्च्या जगदर्चनीयम् <ls>Bk. 2. 20</ls>; महाभागस्तस्मिन्नयमजनि यायावरकुले <ls>B. R. 1. 13</ls> (where यायावर is the name of a family). .²2 A horse selected for a horse-sacrifice. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the sage जरत्कारु. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a family (to which Rājaśekhara belonged). .{@-रम्@} The life of a vagrant mendicant.
